picks.name: DJ Plead
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery -- Smalltown Supersound. Unusually duplicate/year-confusion-heavy research day: Karen y Los Remedios "Bestiaria" and Legowelt's "A Philosophy of Tracking" both turned out to be already-published or misdated. Exact Bandcamp release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to the label's confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Please" (2026, Smalltown Supersound) is the second album from Melbourne producer Jarred Beeler, aka DJ Plead -- built from roughly 120 demos recorded between 2023 and 2025, fusing techno, house and dub with the dabke and mijwiz-flecked keys of a Levantine dancing circle.
picks.why_listen: A genuinely distinct hybrid sound -- Levantine melodic instrumentation folded into club rhythm rather than bolted onto it -- useful for a set that wants a regional texture shift without losing the floor.
